title: Terraforming the Sahara with thunderstorm generators during the humid period

tellings.quote: So these fertilizers are utilized in conjunction with white horseill cumulone nimbus thunderstorm generators for terraforming applications within the upper eastern Sahara.

plain: Fertilizers were once used together with thunderstorm generators to remake the climate of the upper eastern Sahara, says Geoffrey Drumm, who tells Michels about it without naming a source. Drumm places this in the Sahara's humid period, a time when the desert was much wetter. His claim is that the region was deliberately terraformed, meaning reshaped to make it fit for life, by producing storm clouds on purpose.
